summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a pre-feasibility study for its Pilot Mountain tungsten project. The study shows positive economics, including an after-tax NPV of $660.3 million and IRR of 59.6%, but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The filing is a routine operational update on project advancement, not a corporate event triggering special-situation classification.
